classification: newly frozen registration-compatible version of the exploratory conditional hypothesis; motivated by prior R25/R170 results and not an independent discovery claim
question: Among exact daily HS300 members with a positive opening gap of at least 0.5%, does the fraction of that gap still present at the close predict the next five-session return, after matching on gap-size bins?

hypothesis.signal_time: after close on signal date t
hypothesis.universe: exact (query_date, symbol) rows from data/research/r78_daily_membership/daily_snapshots.parquet; never use current members as historical membership
hypothesis.price_source: data/kline_daily_enriched; open and close are the project's adjusted prices
hypothesis.previous_close: close on the immediately preceding exchange trading date; if the symbol lacks a bar on that date, exclude it rather than bridging a suspension
hypothesis.factor: clip((close_t - close_previous_exchange_session) / (open_t - close_previous_exchange_session), -1, 2); higher means a larger share of the opening gap was retained by the close
hypothesis.forward_return: open_(t+1) to open_(t+6), five exchange sessions after the signal close; require every intervening exchange-session bar to exist and do not forward-fill
hypothesis.holding_interpretation: buy at next-session open, exit at the open after five complete sessions; all signal inputs are known at t close

design.sampling: non-overlapping signal dates: every fifth exchange session, anchored to the first session in the R78 daily-membership date calendar; split windows do not reset the anchor
design.primary_metric: date-wise Spearman rank IC between factor and five-session forward return, summarized over the non-overlapping sampled dates
design.primary_comparator: within each signal date, sort event names into five equal-count opening-gap-return bins; demean factor ranks and forward-return ranks within each bin, then compute pooled residual Spearman correlation for that date
design.portfolio_diagnostic: within each signal date, top factor quintile minus bottom factor quintile among eligible gap events, equal weighted; report gross and after 30 bp round-trip costs
design.cost_model: 30 bp round-trip deduction per completed position for the portfolio diagnostic; no leverage
design.data_gaps: missing current-session, immediately previous-session, or any holding-period bar excludes that observation and is reported by split; no forward fill, current-member substitution, or inferred suspension
related_work: R25 tested monthly gap_return, intraday_return, and close_position separately; gap_return and close_position failed their full factor gate
R170 tested a 20-session sum of overnight log return minus intraday log return and failed the overall gate, including discovery and validation performance
design.novelty_limit: This is a conditional normalization of a single-session upward gap and its close outcome, inspired by R25/R170. It is not independent confirmation and may overlap economically with prior gap and intraday-return work.

feasibility_gates.F1_exact_membership_and_price_coverage: in every split, valid current-day and immediately preceding-session member bars cover at least 98% of R78 member-date keys on sampled signal dates
feasibility_gates.F2_event_sample: at least 60 sampled dates and 3000 eligible forward-return observations in each split, with median at least 20 observations per sampled date
feasibility_gates.F3_forward_bar_coverage: at least 98% of otherwise eligible signal events have all five holding-period bars; excluded counts and rates are reported
feasibility_gates.failure_action: if any feasibility gate fails, stop before computing or reading forward-return values; preserve the failed feasibility evidence and do not relax thresholds

decision_gates.G1_discovery: mean weekly-sampled IC >= 0.025 and positive-IC date rate >= 55%
decision_gates.G2_validation: mean weekly-sampled IC >= 0.015 and positive-IC date rate >= 52%
decision_gates.G3_holdout: mean weekly-sampled IC >= 0.010 and positive-IC date rate >= 52%
decision_gates.G4_gap_size_increment: gap-size-bin residual IC >= 0.010 in both validation and holdout
decision_gates.G5_net_spread: top-minus-bottom quintile mean after-cost return > 0 and positive-date rate >= 52% in both validation and holdout
decision_gates.decision: all feasibility gates and G1-G5 must pass; otherwise reject as an effective-alpha candidate. No parameter search, threshold changes, or alternate holding periods after results.

panel.method: Use the same one-shot GET/intent/POST/GET workflow as R306, but only fields accepted by backend/app/backtest/candidates.py factor config allowlist. The full method and all thresholds remain defined in this preregistration; panel config is a compact index only.

prohibitions: Do not use hs300=true because the system applies the current HS300 list across the full backtest interval.
Do not calculate forward returns unless every feasibility gate passes.
Do not treat panel registration as alpha evidence or validation.
Do not publish, deploy, or change production status from this exploration.
The panel config is only an index and must not be mistaken as the complete research contract; use this frozen JSON for the complete definitions.
parent_round: R306 was frozen but its single panel POST was rejected because the factor candidate config contained unsupported research-only fields; no retry was issued and no data feasibility/return analysis was run.
